notes: Selected Any AE in the initial 3-week treatment period because no timepoint is specified in the row. Counts are patients with an AE, not event episodes. Table 8 column order is treatment-period PRM, Placebo, then extension-period PRM, Placebo; the event spans preserve the XML row and its first two data cells, with arm attribution supplied by these column headers. Denominators are explicitly arm-labelled in Table 9 and agree with Table 8. Alternative 26-week extension results in Table 8 are PRM 394 (73.8%) of 534 and Placebo 136 (76.8%) of 177. In the extension, original PRM patients continued and placebo completers were re-randomized to PRM or placebo, so the extension PRM group combines treatment sequences. Safety results cover the overall safety population, not only the age 65-80 efficacy subgroup.
